plugins.name: team
plugins.description: Virtual-team operating model: a CTO/lead supervises on-demand specialists (builder/reviewer/researcher), runs bounded sequential sprints, and gates every change on top of an elevated adversarial reviewer. Project-agnostic — domain knowledge stays in per-project area skills.

plugins.name: paseo-cto
plugins.description: Dual Claude/Codex CTO plugin for a long-running Paseo engineering organization: living execution plans, explicit role skills, dual-provider routing, mandatory scored CTO review, recoverable state, safe cleanup, and 15-minute fleet reconciliation.
